decision.reason: 58/77 = 75.3% passing sites, below the predeclared 80% continuation threshold.

interpretation: The predeclared 25-km open-water-distance metric does not have sufficient support across the frozen terrestrial roster for the planned H2 interaction test.
Coverage failure is concentrated especially in Victoria Land and cannot be repaired by lowering the frozen support rule after H1 is known.
The result is a measurement-support no-go, not evidence that marine accessibility is ecologically unimportant.
boundary: Do not replace the 15% threshold, November-January month set, 1000-km search cap, or median epoch summary after this result.
Do not open alternative marine covariate screens on the same data.
Paper 2 should retain marine mechanism as unresolved.
